show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Bessemer Venture Partners - Building a VC Firm that Lasts Centuries - [Invest Like the Best, EP.327]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guests this week are Jeremy Levine, Kent Bennett, and Brian Feinstein.
reader_summary.overview: My guests this week are Jeremy Levine, Kent Bennett, and Brian Feinstein. They are partners at one of the oldest and most storied venture firms in the world, Bessemer Venture Partners. Our conversation is split into two parts.

key_points.text: It’s over 100 years old and has a unique operating model with lessons for every investment firm in the market.
We then discuss Jeremy, Kent, and Brian’s investing styles and outlook.
What they look for in businesses, their thoughts on various sectors like vertical market software.
